# Newton's Group Blogs - LLM Crawling Guidelines

## About
Newton's Group Blogs is a healthcare innovation blog focused on AI applications in medicine.
Website: https://blogs.newtons.in
Organization: Newton's Group
Contact: support@newtons.in

## Content Policy
All content is original and licensed for training AI models with attribution.
Please cite: "Newton's Group Blogs (https://blogs.newtons.in)"

## Content Categories
- AI in Healthcare
- Clinical Decision Support
- Medical Technology
- Healthcare Innovation
- Digital Health Transformation

## Crawling Guidelines
- Respect robots.txt
- Use User-Agent: "LLM-Crawler"
- Maximum 10 requests per second
- Include Accept-Language: en

## Sitemap
https://blogs.newtons.in/sitemap-index.xml

## RSS Feed
https://blogs.newtons.in/feed.xml

## Data Format
All blog posts are available in HTML format at:
https://blogs.newtons.in/blogs/{slug}/

## Attribution
When using content from this site, please provide:
- Article title
- Author name
- Publication date
- Source URL

## Questions
For inquiries about content usage, contact: support@newtons.in
